title.value: R EPLAY B UFFER W ITH L OCAL F ORGETTING FOR A DAPTIVE D EEP M ODEL -BASED R EINFORCEMENT L EARNING
title.justification: The paper focuses on a novel approach for using replay buffers with local forgetting to enhance adaptability in deep model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL).
title.quote: R EPLAY B UFFER W ITH L OCAL F ORGETTING FOR A DAPTIVE D EEP M ODEL -BASED R EINFORCEMENT L EARNING Anonymous authors Paper under double-blind review

extractions.description: The paper presents a novel approach for adaptive deep model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) using a replay buffer with local forgetting. This method allows the model to adapt effectively to local changes in the environment by maintaining an accurate world model across the relevant state space and mitigating catastrophic forgetting. The method is applied to the Dyna method and MBRL techniques like PlaNet and DreamerV2, demonstrating improved adaptability.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper is primarily centered on technical advancements in reinforcement learning, specifically in improving adaptability and mitigating catastrophic forgetting in deep model-based reinforcement learning.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In this work, we show that a conceptually simple variation of this traditional replay buffer is able to overcome this limitation. By removing only samples from the buffer from the local neighbourhood of the newly observed samples, deep world models can be built that maintain their accuracy across the state-space, while also being able to effectively adapt to changes in the reward function.

primary_category.justification: The paper is focused on technical advancements in reinforcement learning without a direct application to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development contexts.
primary_category.quote: We propose L O F O (Local Forgetting) replay buffer, a conceptually simple variation of the traditional FIFO replay buffer that is able to address the core challenges in building an adaptive deep MBRL method.

primary_sub_category.quote: We demonstrate the effectiveness of the L O F O replay buffer by combining it with a deep version of the classical Dyna method and measuring its adaptivity on a variation of the MountainCar task as well as a mini-grid domain.

applications.justification: The paper demonstrates improvements in adaptability of reinforcement learning models, particularly in adjusting to changing reward functions, which may have broader applications in dynamically changing environments.
applications.quote: Experiments with these modified methods on variations of the MuJoCo Reacher domain demonstrate that a L O F O replay buffer can substantially improve adaptivity of more advanced deep MBRL methods as well.
